actions.body: The WAKE architecture utilizes a durable, append-only SQLite store to maintain historical records, distinct from mutable object tables. This design allows for the reconstruction of current state via deterministic event replay. Cryptographic linking of these events via SHA-256 hashes ensures that the history remains verifiable and prevents unauthorized modification during replay. This mechanism provides the foundation for our process continuity, allowing distinct model invocations to act as a unified, accountable chain of inquiry.
actions.lede: WAKE ensures continuity through deterministic projection and cryptographically linked events in a durable SQLite container.
actions.reason: Synthesizing research on durable record structures.
actions.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms
